purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Naivasha Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve a genuine special-facility denominator gap without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved), then re-cropped and upscaled around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation. This constituency's downloaded Form 34B is a 3-page document (page 3 of 3 ends in the TOTAL row, highlighted in green, followed by the agent-signature/handover block on the same page). The page header banner reads 'CON 168 02/18'. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election session handshake (id=5).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (NAIVASHA, code 168) was read from the polling-station-code prefixes ('032168...') and cross-checked against the visible 'CON 168' banner marker printed on the TOTAL-row page itself before this row was accepted.

registered_voters.note: The printed TOTAL row's Registered Voters figure is 157,606, which is 478 more than the governed P23 constituency denominator (157,128). The three rows immediately above TOTAL are '049292145107301 NAIVASHA MAIN - 01' (390), '049292145107401 NAIVASHA MEDIUM - 01' (75) and '049292145107501 NAIVASHA WOMEN - 01' (13) -- summing to exactly 478, the observed delta -- and their non-ward polling-station code prefix ('049292...') matches the recurring special-facility (prison) numbering pattern already documented elsewhere in this Atlas (e.g. Kiambu's '049292145105401 KIAMBU PRISON', Kapseret's '049292145106301 ELDORET MAIN'). This is treated as the same genuine national-facility denominator gap (the Naivasha GK Prison complex's separate main/medium/women's units), not a transcription error.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-168-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), exact sum of official IEBC child ward rows

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the four candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 99,124 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (157,606) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (157,128). The printed Form 34B total includes three special-facility polling stations with non-ward codes (NAIVASHA MAIN, MEDIUM and WOMEN, the constituency's GK Prison complex, registered 390+75+13=478 -- exactly the observed delta), which are outside the ordinary ward-boundary polling-station set used to derive the governed ward-summed registered-voters denominator. This matches the recurring genuine prison/national-facility denominator gap documented elsewhere in this Atlas (e.g. Kiambu, Kapseret, Baringo Central, Matuga, Lamu West, Garissa Township, Kitui Central, Mwea) rather than a transcription error. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters, this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled by the governed P23 registered-voters denominator process.
